phase: Phase 1: CI workflow runs the repo checks (due 2026-11-25)
summary: The phase passes acceptance at HEAD c74252d. Each task and acceptance criterion has proof from a command or a read-only GitHub call. The workflow runs the four checks on pull requests and on pushes to main. Main requires the `checks` status. Two nonblocking gaps remain: one in the contract test and one in the closeout record.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: tests/ci/test-workflow.sh does not reject a masked gate. Five probe copies of ci.yml exit 0 with 19 PASS (see the probe evidence entry). The probes add continue-on-error, a `|| true` suffix, a step `if: false`, a job `if: false`, or a pull_request `branches` filter. The delivered ci.yml holds none of these, and FR-3 does not list them. A later edit could mask the required check and keep the test green. Record one tech-debt row at closeout, with F1 of Review A. No Green round is needed.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The closed no-CI row hides three suites that CI does not run. The old row named `node --test` and guard `bun test` as CI scope. The three suites are plugins/dsh-measure-guard (`node --test`, 28 files), plugins/dsh-idle-compaction (`node --test`), and plugins/opencode-measure-guard (`bun test`). measure/gates.json PROJECT_TESTS also runs the first suite. The PM set the four-command scope in the spec, so this is a record gap and not a defect. Record one Open tech-debt row at closeout unless the PM declines it.
